body_markdown:
Origin Bancorp, Inc. (TXSE: OBK) ("Origin"), the holding company for Origin Bank, announced today that its common stock commenced trading at market open on the Texas Stock Exchange ("TXSE") under its current ticker symbol, "OBK". The commencement of trading completes Origin’s previously announced transfer of its stock exchange listing from the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") to the TXSE.


"As we begin trading on the Texas Stock Exchange, our listing is now located in one of the country’s fastest growing business centers where we have established a strong footprint,” said Drake Mills, chairman, president and CEO of Origin Bancorp, Inc. “We are proud to join the TXSE as a founding member and look forward to continuing to deliver elite-level financial performance and creating long-term value for our employees, customers, communities and stockholders."


"We welcome Origin Bancorp to the Texas Stock Exchange on its first day of trading," said James H. Lee, chairman and CEO of the Texas Stock Exchange. “Origin is a respected regional banking franchise with roots in Louisiana and an important and growing presence across Texas. We are proud to support their next chapter as a TXSE-listed issuer."


No action is required by stockholders with respect to the transfer of the listing. Investors can continue to trade shares of Origin stock through customary trading platforms.


**About Origin Bancorp, Inc.**


Origin Bancorp, Inc. is a financial holding company headquartered in Ruston, Louisiana. Origin’s wholly owned bank subsidiary, Origin Bank, was founded in 1912 in Choudrant, Louisiana. Deeply rooted in Origin’s history is a culture committed to providing personalized relationship banking to businesses, municipalities, and personal clients to enrich the lives of the people in the communities it serves. Origin provides a broad range of financial services and currently operates more than 57 locations in Dallas/Fort Worth, East Texas, Houston, North Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama and the Florida Panhandle. In addition, Origin provides a broad range of insurance agency products and services through its wholly owned insurance agency subsidiary, Forth Insurance, LLC. For more information, visit www.origin.bank and[www.forthinsurance.com.](http://www.forthinsurance.com./)
